section.title: Partnering with Industry Associations
section.subtitle: Empowering guild and union members across Kerala with digital visibility and direct access to production opportunities.
section.description: CrewHive collaborates with recognized professional guilds, trade unions, and technical associations in Kerala's film, audio-visual, and live event sectors. We provide dedicated onboarding tracks, member roster digitization, and credential verification to help your members get hired directly without intermediaries.

benefits.title: Bulk Member Onboarding
benefits.description: Streamlined onboarding assistance for your certified technicians via dedicated WhatsApp and web portals.

benefits.title: Verified Guild Credential Badges
benefits.description: Highlight certified association membership on public profiles to signal verified training and trust.

benefits.title: Transparent Industry Demand
benefits.description: Equip association leadership with real-time insight into industry demand trends, technical crafts, and regional work volume.

benefits.title: Zero Commission on Wages
benefits.description: CrewHive does not take cuts from technician fees or day rates. Direct remuneration is protected.
